tools.referenceBehavior:
Per-frame executed-PC histogram over VI frames [start_frame, start_frame+n_frames).

Runs from now (start_frame defaults to the current frame or accepts "now"; past frames are rejected),
on the interpreter. Returns records (pc, frame, count) sorted by frame then pc,
unique_pcs, traced_instructions, complete/truncated. Optional half-open PC filter.
Large results: pass `path` (JSON file) and/or page with trace_page.
tools.requiredBackend: Core traces, callsite/target filters and arguments, pagination/counters, DMA ring, profiler.
tools.implementationStatus: MCP implemented (bounded N64 trace slice; task 6 incomplete)
tools.mcpSchemaParity: Source names/defaults retained; numeric/storage/response limits bounded. File paths explicitly unavailable. Full generated FastMCP/result equality not run.

testEvidence.result: Passed in 25-test service suite: actual MIPS PC/call capture, JALR rd=rs, filters, caps/overflow, native call serialization, freed buffers and real JIT restoration; real MCP paging, timeout, future intervals and disconnect cleanup.

tools.knownLimits: Owned N64 interpreter interval with sorted per-frame PCs, filters and counters. Up to 262144 stored records; outside-RDRAM map bounded and counters saturate with explicit overflow. MCP inline/page responses cap at 1024 entries with next_offset. File export unavailable until task 7.

tools.name: call_function
tools.referenceBehavior:
Experimental bounded RDRAM function call with up to four raw integer arguments.

Requires a paused machine with valid aligned stack and no delay/exception context.
t9 is set to entry; a private return gate uses no instruction patches. Success
returns v0/v1 and restores caller GPR/HI/LO/PC, FPR/FCR31 and Status; LLbit is
cleared. Other COP0/time, memory and device effects remain. Interrupts/exceptions,
watch/break hits and limits leave the actual stop intact for call_recover.
